analysis: SHAP explainability for final production spatial-anomaly model
raw_shap_definition: Feature contributions to raw LightGBM spatial-anomaly output
centered_shap_definition: Within-year raw SHAP contribution minus the same feature's mean SHAP contribution across all 2,194 grids in that year
centered_shap_identity: sum(centered feature SHAP values) = centered model-predicted spatial anomaly
global_importance_definition: Mean absolute centered SHAP contribution across all 17,552 2018-2025 production-training rows

trajectory_conditioned_shap.interpretation: Model-based SHAP patterns associated with trajectory classes; not causal explanations of trajectory formation

future_shap_deferred: 2026-2030 future SHAP is deferred until future predictors, annual thermal-level forecasts, and future LST predictions exist
interpretation: Positive centered SHAP pushes a grid hotter relative to Kaduwela's annual thermal level; negative centered SHAP pushes it cooler relative to that level
causal_warning: SHAP explains the fitted model. It does not prove causal effects.
evaluation_warning: 2018-2025 rows are used for production-model explanation only. Step 24 does not create a new held-out accuracy result.
